title: Removing Service Parts makes the Service Labor person the one rep
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have three active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A, sales rep B and sales rep C, so that each customer field holds a different person.
  • Create a customer for this test with "Sales Representative - Service Labor" set to sales rep A, "Sales Representative - Service Parts" set to sales rep B and "Sales Representative - Part Sales" set to sales rep C, so you can see which person stays when Service Parts is removed.
  • Open the customer's Edit Customer window in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the remove x beside "Sales Representative - Service Parts".
  2. Save the customer and look at its page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Service Parts goes away.
  • The first field is renamed "Sales Representative".
  • It reads sales rep A.
  • "Sales Representative - Part Sales" still reads sales rep C.

Step 2:

  • The page shows "Sales Representative" sales rep A and "Sales Representative - Part Sales" sales rep C.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R11: “Removing Service Parts renames the first field "Sales Representative" again. It keeps the Service Labor person, who becomes the customer's one representative for labor and parts. A Part Sales field, if added, keeps its choice.”
  • S4-R19: “The customer page shows the representatives with the window's labels, in the window's order: "Sales Representative" or "Sales Representative - Service Labor", then "Sales Representative - Service Parts" when added, then "Sales Representative - Part Sales" when added. An empty one reads "Unassigned". The Sales Representative rows show on every customer, whether or not the customer has an address. The other fields on the page keep today's rule of showing only when the customer has an address.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
